_note: How generated missions set up each sitrep (rules text: data/lancer-data/sitreps.json). Our own data. Every lancer-data sitrep is generated. objective_size: the Escort/Extraction Objective's Size (the book allows 1/2 to 2).
_safety_note: max_rounds stops a Basic Combat that nobody can finish (GM calls it a draw). It's a GM option, not a book rule.
_budget_note: PROVISIONAL encounter size: enemy budget = players x per_player x difficulty, each NPC costs its template 'cost' (default 1). Not the book's encounter guidance yet.
_map_sizes_note: Map width x height: (base + per_player x squad size) x the sitrep's [width, height] factors, +- jitter, kept in [min, max]. The extra room is flanking space; GmSettings.approach keeps the deployment zones close (SitrepLayout).
